title: Nixon takes Jackie Gleason to Homestead AFB
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Nixon takes Jackie Gleason to Homestead AFB, about 1973 at Homestead Air Force Base, Florida, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's this famous story of Nixon showing up at Jackie Gleason's place in 1973 and telling him, "We have secret UFO technology, taking him to Homestead Air Force Base."

>> Homestead. And there he encountered a recovered crashed UFO and they had biological alien bodies that were in freezers. And uh Gleason was so profoundly affected by it, it became a UFO nut, which is absolutely true.
tellings.difference: Adds a crashed craft and alien bodies in freezers, and credits a magazine article.
tellings.link_reason: The same story of Nixon taking Jackie Gleason to Homestead AFB to see secret UFO material.

as_told.title: Nixon shows Jackie Gleason a crashed UFO and frozen alien bodies at Homestead AFB
